exceptions.reason: Mozilla web-ext reaches node-forge only through adbkit, which it uses to drive Firefox for Android over ADB during manual `web-ext run` sessions. Ghostify's scripts and CI only run `web-ext lint`, which never loads adbkit. The advisory affects RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification and has no patched node-forge release as of 2026-10-15. Runtime dependency audits remain fully blocking.
